mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather. Conditions are clear at Fireman's Park with a temperature of 52 degrees. We are under a Waxing Crescent moon tonight, and the temperature will dip to an overnight low of 47 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In recent city news, Verona police reported on a residential burglary that took place on September 10th at a home on Hunter's Cove Way. Officers arrived at 9:31 p.m. to find a suspect in the act, and following a brief encounter involving a discharged firearm, the 19-year-old suspect was taken into custody with no civilian injuries reported.

Looking at the calendar, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow. Next week is packed with excitement including Hop Haus Trivia, Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee, the Downtown Farmer's Market on September 16th, and various live music performances throughout the week.

On September 10th, officers responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way, leading to the arrest of a 19-year-old Madison resident who is now facing charges for burglary and recklessly endangering safety.
Today's flavor was Really Reese's. Since the store is currently closed for the night, please check back tomorrow at 10:00 AM when the doors open for the next flavor of the day.
